title: DoSe Turmeric Curcumin C3 Complex, 60 Capsules - VictoriaHealth
abstract:
This high strength curcumin supplement contains an extract derived from the rhizomes (roots) of the plant Curcuma longa, also known as turmeric. Unlike turmeric tea, these curcumin capsules contain a three curcumin compounds obtained from the dried rhizomes of Curcuma longa (Turmeric) and standardized to provide a minimum of 95% Curcuminoids. The name Curcumin C3 has reference to its three main chemical compounds - Curcumin, Demethoxycurcumin (DMC) and Bisdemethoxycurcumin (BDMC)—collectively known as “Curcuminoids”.  
The most important factor in choosing an effective curcumin supplement is bioavailability as well as absorption. Curcumin C3 Complex is a premium and patented form of curcumin. It has the highest absorption of any curcumin on the market (95% absorption of curcuminoids). We further increase the absorption by adding Bioperine® (a patented form of Piperine).  
Because better health benefits come from better bioavailability, this turmeric supplement provides more health benefits for your heart, brain, joints, immune and circulation, and beyond.  
**DoSe Turmeric Curcumin Benefits:**  
- Advanced, comprehensive formula
- Powerful Antioxidant Properties
- Supports collagen formation for healthy cartilage function
- Reduces both inflammation & triglycerides
- Added BioPerine® for improved absorption and bioavailability
- Each capsule provides 500mg of Curcumin C3 Complex.
- Curcumin is the active ingredient in Turmeric.
- Provides 95% Total Curcuminoids.

**Is Curcumin C3 Complex the same as turmeric?**  
- Turmeric is one of the ancient spice used in Ayurvedic medicine providing benefits for pain relief, reducing inflammation, antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
- Curcumin C3 Complex is an extract derived from the rhizomes (roots) of the plant Curcuma longa, also known as turmeric, which contains three of the most studied compounds found in turmeric root.
- Curcumin C3 Complex is the foremost clinically-studied natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant with a variety of health benefits containing compounds obtained from turmeric root
- Curcumin C3 Complex is the gold standard for turmeric extracts
- Curcumin C3 Complex is self-affirmed GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe)  
**Is this a curcumin supplement?**
Curcumin C3 Complex is a mixture of curcuminoids, not just curcumin. Curcumin C3 Complex is curcumin plus demethoxycurcumin and bisdemethoxycurcumin.  
**How pure is Curcumin C3 Complex?**
Sabinsa’s Curcumin C3 Complex contains minimum 95% curcuminoids. Sabinsa’s manufacturing facility is ISO-certified to ensure that it is free from impurities and contaminants.
**Is Curcumin C3 Complex sustainably sourced?**
Yes, Curcumin C3 Complex is extracted from sustainably-grown*Curcuma longa*  
**Is the plant, Curcumin C3 Complex, extracted a genetically-modified organism (GMO)?**
No, the plant is not genetically modified. Therefore, Curcumin C3 Complex is not GMO.  
**What isBioPerine®?**
BioPerine®is a patented standardized extract obtained from black pepper, containing not less than 95% piperine. It is aclinically proven bioavailability enhancer for nutrients\*. (*Basu, T.K.: The influence of drugs with particular reference to aspirin on bioavailability of Vitamin C; in Counsell, Hornig, Vitamin C, pp.273-281 (Applied Science Publishers, Barking 1981)  
**Is BioPerine® the same thing as black pepper?**
Black pepper can bereferred to as piperine and it is actually the active component of black pepper that gives you the benefits.
